item.text: {"summary":"Draft is mostly coherent, but it should align the published resolver/source fields with the ledger binding before publication.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"resolver","severity":"blocking","summary":"The draft resolutionSourceUrl points to the live BLS Table 2 page, while the canonical ledger sourceBinding resolves via ALFRED/FRED series IQ with allowed host alfred.stlouisfed.org and first_print policy.","actionRequested":"Keep the same target and BLS Table 2 resolver text, but make the source fields explicitly consistent with the ledger binding or explain the BLS-vs-ALFRED discrepancy in the reasoning without silently changing the target."}],"optionalSuggestions":["State the historical sample as June 2025 through June 2026 excluding missing lapse months, and note that the 80% interval is an approximate normal-volatility interval from that 11-observation sample.","The tail scenarios are acceptable; adding one sentence on how much energy/industrial-supplies weight would have to move to breach the interval would make them more concrete."]}
